updates.name: Matthew A. Reidenbach
updates.bio: Chairs the University of Virginia's Department of Environmental Sciences, where he is a professor, and holds a courtesy appointment in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering. His coastal oceanography research examines hydrodynamic influences on marine life: how flow and turbulence shape coral reef nutrient exchange, estuarine larval transport, chemical dispersal at sea, waves, and nature-based protection of coastlines.
updates.research_interests: coastal oceanography; flow and turbulence controls on coral reef nutrient exchange; estuarine larval transport; chemical dispersal in the ocean; wave dynamics; nature-based coastal protection and resilience
updates.current_title: Professor and Department Chair, Department of Environmental Sciences
updates.evidence: Matthew A. Reidenbach Department Chair, Professor
updates.notes: Lab page reidenbach.evsc.virginia.edu (200) and UVA EVSC profile evsc.as.virginia.edu/people/matthew-reidenbach (200) both name him Professor and Chair, Environmental Sciences, UVA; neither mentions VCR LTER (affiliation rests on NSF award 2425178). Lab page uses 'he' for him.
